name: Project Angels 2
source:
Project Angels 2 is a military themed visual novel.

Steel Waters and Apollyon—two warring factions of the ANGELS super soldiers have tormented the waters of the Indicus Ocean for years. Their maker, a Puppetmaster turned Savior, now aims to balance the two beliefs of liberty and stability, all while reuniting what was once whole under a new home.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4766910]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《天使计划2》是一部军事题材视觉小说。

“钢铁水域”与“亚波伦”——隶属于“天使”（ANGELS）超级士兵计划的两大敌对阵营，多年来在印第库斯洋海域征战不休、掀起无尽战火。如今，从幕后傀儡师蜕变为救世主的造物主，决心在“自由”与“稳定”这两种信念之间寻求平衡，将昔日分裂的一切重新凝聚于崭新的家园之下。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4766910]Steam[/url]]
